request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, How do radio choices map custom label and value properties and disable an individual option?
usable_if: Shared mapping labelProp/valueProp/disabledProp and option.disabled binding; not raw Material-only props.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, When field.focus becomes true for a radio group with the default tabindex, which button does Formly try to focus?
usable_if: Default -1; after view init scheduled selected-or-first focus when radios exist, not arbitrary timing guarantee.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Does FormlyMaterialModule register the radio type, and which component and wrapper does that registration use?
usable_if: Aggregate imports radio module; radio component and form-field wrapper.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, How does native-select bind option values and grouped options, and what value does its placeholder option represent?
usable_if: ngValue for option/children, optgroup, truthy placeholder adds undefined option.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Does a readonly binding on native-select prove that browser selection is prevented or that the value is excluded from submission?
usable_if: Binding exists; no functional browser readonly, disabled equivalence or payload guarantee.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Is native-select registered by FormlyMaterialModule, and what module, component and wrapper supply its registration?
usable_if: Separate FormlyMatNativeSelectModule, FormlyFieldNativeSelect, form-field; absent aggregate.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Which common controls are imported by FormlyMaterialModule, and does that include toggle and native-select?
usable_if: List seven imported modules including form-field; toggle/native-select absent.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, How are the string, number and integer input aliases registered, and does integer alone establish integer-only validation?
usable_if: All extend input; number/integer default props.type number; no integer-only validation inference.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, Can native-select disable both ordinary and grouped child options, and does that mean all mat-select settings are forwarded?
usable_if: Both option.disabled/child.disabled, no every mat-select prop guarantee.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, If I override a radio group tabindex to 0, does its field.focus observer still take the same selected-or-first focus branch?
usable_if: No: inspected branch requires props.tabindex === -1; not all-browser keyboard claim.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, how do I keep a hidden field value without promising the control stays registered?
usable_if: resetOnHide false; hidden control can unregister.

request: In Formly 6.3.12 Material, how do I enable textarea autosize with minimum and maximum rows?
In Formly 6.3.12 Material, how does multicheckbox array mode compare object values?
usable_if: indexOf/strict equality identity; no structural equality.

request: In Formly 7 Material, how is native-select registered?
In Formly 6.3.12 Bootstrap, are the Material radio focus defaults guaranteed?
usable_if: Stop unsupported adapter; no Material guarantee.
